goal: Replace ad-hoc next-device selection with a repeatable 2026 exact-model normalization audit while preserving the 802-URL SEO observation surface.
engineering: Added scripts/phase142-device-normalization-audit.mjs as a repeatable audit generator.
Added assets/data/phase142-2026-normalization-audit-v1.json as the current prioritized backlog.
The audit deep-merges the base Device Passport dataset with all current-device overlays in phase order.
External field-test evidence and SolQvia-owned real-device evidence are scored separately from structural completeness.
No public URL, canonical, or Device Passport record count changes are introduced in Phase142.
evidence_rules: Missing model number is weighted more heavily than secondary metadata gaps.
Generic SIM placeholders are treated as unresolved, but known nanoSIM/eSIM support is not penalized simply because simultaneous use remains unverified.
Dual-SIM exactness is a separate gap from basic SIM/eSIM support.
Band tables and sales-channel fit do not prove runtime compatibility.
External tests do not become SolQvia real-device evidence.
qa_targets: Audit script is syntactically valid as an ES module.
Audit backlog is deterministic for a fixed repository state.
Top-priority families reflect aggregate structural gaps rather than manual preference.
No public indexable URL is created or removed.

phase143_recommendation.reason: Three S26 families tie for the highest aggregate priority and already have external runtime evidence, so exact-model/carrier normalization can close multiple high-value gaps efficiently.
